subject: Phased hosted-API uplift, temporary graceband & procurement milestones
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Simon Park <simon.park@edgecommerce.com>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@edgecommerce.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Phased uplift proposal for EdgeCommerce
Attachments: ECS_Phased_Uplift_Proposal.pdf (proposal, 2 pages)

Hi Simon / Alex,

Following our call this morning, attached is a concise proposal to support EdgeCommerce's surge ahead of the holiday window. Key points at a glance: 

- Phased monthly commit increases over three months: +30% (Month 1), +50% (Month 2), +80% (Month 3) relative to current baseline.
- Temporary graceband (10% overage waiver) for the first 60 days while we monitor traffic curves.
- Soft-throttle thresholds adjusted to reduce tail-latency risk at peak times (ops policy included).
- Updated per-token rate tiers for the uplifted commits; example pricing in the attachment.

Operational asks from your side: procurement PO or signed SOW to lock in committed units; preferred start date and billing cadence. We can coordinate a single onboarding window (1–2 weeks) once PO is in.

I've cc'd Karthik for rateband confirmation and Naomi for billing cadence / invoicing lead time. If this looks good, I can convert the attachment into an SOW and route for signatures.

Thanks — talk soon,

Irene Choi
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0224

From: Simon Park <simon.park@edgecommerce.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: EdgeCommerce Procurement <procure@edgecommerce.com>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@edgecommerce.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Phased uplift proposal for EdgeCommerce

Thanks, Irene — appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear phases. A few clarifying items before we escalate to procurement: 

1) Can you confirm whether the 10% graceband is a true waiver (no charge) or a credit applied to the following month? Our finance team needs the exact treatment for forecasting.
2) For the soft-throttle rules: will Redwood provide automatic fallback to a lower-cost compatible model if we hit throttles during a sales spike? We want to avoid failed requests at the checkout flow.
3) Lead time for invoices / PO effectivity: procurement requires a two-week lead time after PO receipt for internal processing. Is Oct 26 acceptable as an effective start date if we submit PO by Oct 20?

CC'ing procurement so they see the timeline constraints. Also, can you attach an SOW draft (single page) with the exact commit numbers and rate bands? That will speed up procurement review.

Cheers,
Simon
Head of Platform Engineering
EdgeCommerce
Simon.Park@edgecommerce.com

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Phased uplift proposal for EdgeCommerce — need rateband treatment and PO timeline

Team — forwarding Simon's reply. Short answers and proposed play: 

- Graceband treatment: recommended as a true waiver for the first 60 days (we absorb up to 10% above committed tokens) to remove friction on EdgeCommerce during ramp. Finance impact is small if we limit to 60 days; Ben, can you confirm?
- Soft-throttle / fallback: we can configure automatic routing to a compatible model variant (quantized lower-cost model) for non-critical calls (e.g., background tasks). For checkout APIs we keep strict latency SLOs and rely on burst capacity. Karthik — can we codify a fallback policy that avoids 5xx at the edge?
- PO timing: procurement asks for two-week lead time. If they send PO by Oct 20, start date Oct 26 is OK. Naomi — confirm invoice timing and whether we should prorate first month.

Suggest we send a one-page SOW that enumerates commits, rate tiers, the 60-day waiver clause, and the planned start date window. I'll draft that and include the SOW_EdgeCommerce_v1.docx as the working draft.

Irene

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Simon Park <simon.park@edgecommerce.com>, EdgeCommerce Procurement <procure@edgecommerce.com>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@edgecommerce.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Phased uplift proposal for EdgeCommerce — confirmed terms & next steps
Attachments: SOW_EdgeCommerce_v1.docx (draft SOW, 1 page)

Hi Simon / Alex / Procurement team,

Thanks for the quick back-and-forth. Per internal alignment, confirming the terms we can commit to in writing: 

1) Commits and cadence (monthly billing):
   - Month 1 start (effective Oct 26): +30% committed tokens
   - Month 2: +50% committed tokens
   - Month 3: +80% committed tokens
   - Billing will be monthly; first invoice prorated from Oct 26 to Nov 1 if PO is received by Oct 20.

2) Graceband waiver:
   - We will waive charges for up to 10% overage on committed tokens for the first 60 days from go-live (no charge). Any overage beyond that will be billed at the agreed overage rate in the SOW.

3) Soft-throttle / fallback policy: 
   - For non-critical endpoints (identified in the SOW appendix), automatic fallback to a compatible lower-cost model variant is permitted to preserve authenticated throughput.
   - For checkout/critical endpoints, Redwood will prioritize burst capacity and apply soft-throttle cushions; we will not return 5xx for requests we can route. Exact endpoint list in the SOW appendix.

4) PO & onboarding timeline:
   - Procurement submits PO by Oct 20; effective start Oct 26.
   - Onboarding window: standard 1-week ops onboarding followed by 1 week of staged traffic ramping.

Attached is a one-page SOW draft (SOW_EdgeCommerce_v1.docx) that mirrors the bullets above and includes the numerical commit and rateband table. If procurement is comfortable, please return a signed PO referencing deal ECS-2026-0134.

Next steps: 
- Alex: please confirm the endpoint list for critical checkout traffic (reply to this thread).
- Procurement: confirm PO timeline and any required billing remittance instructions.
- I'll update the SOW to include endpoint IDs and finalize sign-off.

Happy to jump on a quick call if you'd prefer to walk procurement through the SOW.

Best,

Irene Choi
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
